def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    from datetime import date

    start_date = date(2023, 3, 1)
    end_date = date(2023, 9, 1)
    nominal_rate = 0.07
    principal = 200000
    days_in_year = 365

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    days_accrued = (end_date - start_date).days
    accrued_interest = principal * nominal_rate * days_accrued / days_in_year
    answer = round(accrued_interest, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
